hit.text: Sundered (a target can spend an action to remove it).

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

2 Actions (1 scrap): Requires a Firearm. Range 6, Blast 3, Damage STRd4. On damage: inflict Sundered. Affected targets can spend an action to remove the condition.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): On damage: inflict Sundered for 2 attacks.

Passive: Acid damage you deal ignores Medium Armor.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Rolls STRd4 damage (Acid assumed; the book omits the type).

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Acid Shell (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Acid Shell" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Nimble has no Sundered condition — track Sundered on damaged targets yourself.
